result.topic_en: Faint pencil calculations, apparently on the energy or work of a deformed elastic or rotating body (expressions in a, b, p, q, R, with a 'Torsion' heading), mixed with some upside-down jottings of series and integrals involving powers and logarithms.
result.transcription:
[?]
$\frac{4\delta P}{\pi \Delta R^2 l} = \delta p\,(ap + 2b(q+m)) + \delta q\,(2bp + 2(a+b)(q+m))$
$= p\,\delta p\,\frac{(a-b)(a+2b)}{(a+b)}$
Torsion[?]
$\frac{-4\delta P}{2\pi\Delta R^2 l} = \frac{1}{2}R^2(a-b)\,m\,\delta m + 2\delta p\,(ap+2bq) + 4\delta q\,((a+b)q+bp)$
[upside-down and very faint calculations with series, logarithms ($\log$) and integrals such as $\int_0^\infty \frac{1-e^{-x}}{x}\,dx$ [?], not reliably legible]
